45100.synonym: cāgī, jaha, paṭinissaggī, pahāyaka, vijahanta, ha
45100.commentary: (NIDD2) sabbakāyappahāyino'ti sabbo tassa paṭisandhiko rūpakāyo pahīno, tadaṅgasamatikkamā vikkhambhanappahānena pahīno tassa rūpakāyo'ti, sabbakāyappahāyino. (SNPa) sabbakāyappahāyino'ti tadaṅgavikkhambhanavasena sabbarūpakāyappahāyino, pahīna-rūpabhava-paṭisandhikassā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.
kusalī bhāsasī tesaṃ, mārapāsappahāyinaṃ, kassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.

tasmā't'iha, phagguna, tava ce'pi koci pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya, leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya, daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya, satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya, tatrā'pi tvaṃ, phagguna, ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
seyyathā'pi saha bhaṇḍena gahitacoraṃ, vadhetha nan'ti rañño āṇāya rājapurisā bandhitvā catukke catukke pahārasatāni dentā āghātanaṃ nenti.
atha kho, pāpima, dūsī māro aññataraṃ kumārakaṃ anvāvisitvā sakkharaṃ gahetvā āyasmato vidhurassa sīse pahāram'adāsi, sīsaṃ vobhindi.

45105.meaning1: regularly beaten; expecting a beating; accustomed to beatings
45105.commentary: (VINa) te pahārasamuccitā rodantī'ti te pahāraparicitā pubbe'pi laddhapahārattā idāni ca pahāraṃ dassantī'ti maññamānā rodantī'ti attho. pahārassa muccitā'ti'pi sajjhāyanti, tattha pahārassa bhītā'ti attho.

examples.text: kiṃ, je, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti? na khv'ayye, kiñcī'ti. no vata re kiñci, pāpi dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti kupitā anattamanā aggaḷasūciṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ adāsi, sīsaṃ vobhindi.

45108.commentary: (VIN 2.5.8.4) pahāraṃ dadeyyā'ti kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā antamaso uppalapattena'pi pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano pahāraṃ dadeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

tasmā't'iha, phagguna, tava ce'pi koci pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya, leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya, daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya, satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya, tatrā'pi tvaṃ, phagguna, ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
pahāraṃ dadeyyā'ti kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā antamaso uppalapattena'pi pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
bhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me na'y'ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī'ti. evam'ettha, bhagavā, bhavissati, evam'ettha, sugata, bhavissatī'ti.

45110.commentary: (ANa) pahārādo'ti evaṃnāmako. (APt) surehi saddhiṃ saṅgām'atthaṃ attano balakāyānaṃ pahāraṃ āyudhaṃ dadātī'ti pahārado, so eva pahārādo.

examples.text: kālakañcā mahābhismā, asurā dānaveghasā, vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī saha.
nadato parisāyaṃ te, vādīdappāpahārino, ye te dakkhanti vadanaṃ, dhaññā te narapuṅgava.

45113.commentary: (SNa) pahāso nāma nirayo'ti visuṃ pahāsanāmako nirayo nāma n'atthi, avīciss'eva pana ekasmiṃ koṭṭhāse naccantā viya gāyantā viya ca naṭavesaṃ gahetvā'va paccanti, taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā mohanīyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyosomattāya. so attanā matto pamatto pare madetvā pamādetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pahāso nāma nirayo tattha upapajjati.

45114.commentary: (SNa) pahāsi saṅkhan'ti padassa hi ayam'ev'attho, ratto duṭṭho mūḷho iti imaṃ paṇṇattiṃ khīṇ'āsavo pahāsi jahi pajahī'ti.

examples.text: pahāsi saṅkhaṃ na vimānam'ajjhagā, acchecchi taṇhaṃ idha nāmarūpe, taṃ chinnaganthaṃ anighaṃ nirāsaṃ, pariyesamānā n'ājjhagamuṃ, devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā sabbanivesanesu.
et'ābhinandāmi vaco mah'esino, sukittitaṃ gotam'anūpadhīkaṃ, addhā hi bhagavā pahāsi dukkhaṃ, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

45118.meaning1: will give up; will let go; will abandon

examples.text: cirassaṃ vata me mahito mah'esī, mahāvanaṃ pāpuṇi saccavādī, so'haṃ cirassā'pi pahāssaṃ pāpaṃ sutvāna gāthaṃ tava dhammayuttaṃ.
khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti dūteyya-pahiṇagaman'ānuyogā paṭivirato hoti kayavikkayā paṭivirato hoti
dūteyyapahiṇagamana-anuyogā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kayavikkayā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, tulākūṭakaṃsakūṭamānakūṭā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, ukkoṭana-vañcana-nikati-sāciyogā paṭivirato ahosiṃ

45121.commentary: (VINa) pahiṇeyyā'ti peseyya, uttānatthattā pan'assa padabhājanaṃ na vuttaṃ.

examples.text: purisassa mātā bhikkhuṃ pahiṇati… purisassa pitā bhikkhuṃ pahiṇati… purisassa mātāpitaro bhikkhuṃ pahiṇanti… purisassa bhātā bhikkhuṃ pahiṇati… purisassa bhaginī bhikkhuṃ pahiṇati… purisassa ñātakā bhikkhuṃ pahiṇanti…
tassa te ahaṃ, mahārāja, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ pahiṇissāmi, abhiruheyyāsi, mahārāja, dibbaṃ yānaṃ avikampamāno'ti. adhivāsesi kho, ānanda, nimi rājā tuṇhībhāvena.
idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilāno hoti. so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya, ahañ'hi gilāno, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan'ti.
yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇittha, na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti, yuñjant'āyasmanto sakaṃ, mā vo sakaṃ vinassā'ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato
sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yam'ahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā ekā vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpinī pahit'attā vihareyyan'ti.
sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyyā'ti itthiyā vā pahito purisassa santike gacchati, purisena vā pahito itthiyā santike gacchati.
ahañ'hi gilāno, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan'ti, gantabbaṃ, bhikkhave, satt'āhakaraṇīyena, appahite'pi, pag'eva pahite.

45130.synonym: catta, jahita, paṭinissaṭṭha, pariccatta, pahīna, vijahita, vitiṇṇa, vippahīna, vossaṭṭha

examples.text: atthi kho, gahapati, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato avimuttañ'c'eva cittaṃ vimuccati

45131.commentary: (SNa) pahit'atto'ti pesit'atto. (SNt) pesit'atto'ti nibbānaṃ pati pesitacitto. (SNPa) padhānapahit'attan'ti nibbān'atthāya pesitacittaṃ

examples.text: sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yam'ahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā ekā vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpinī pahit'attā vihareyyan'ti
ky'āssa byappathayo assu, ky'āss'assu idha gocarā, kāni sīlabbatān'āssu, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.
sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yam'ahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā ekā vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpinī pahit'attā vihareyyan'ti
ky'āssa byappathayo assu, ky'āss'assu idha gocarā, kāni sīlabbatān'āssu, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.

45133.meaning1: abandoned; dispelled; eliminated; removed; given up
45133.synonym: apahata, catta, jahita, paṭinissaṭṭha, paṭivinīta, pariccatta, bāhita, byantīkata, vijahita, vitiṇṇa, vippahīna, vossaṭṭha

examples.text: kathañ'ca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti. idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.
abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, bhāvetabbañ'ca bhāvitaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddho'smi brāhmaṇa.

45135.meaning1: who has left behind birth and death

examples.text: cittaṃ visuddhaṃ jānāti, muttaṃ rāgehi sabbaso. pahīnajātimaraṇo, brahmacariyassa kevalī, pāragū sabbadhammānaṃ, buddho tādī pavuccatī'ti.

45136.construction:
pa + √hā > hī + na + tta
pahīna + tta

examples.text: moho pahīno hoti. mohassa pahīnattā pare na kopenti, parehi kopiyamāno kopaṃ na pātukaroti. so sorato'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

yassa so kodho pahīno samucchinno vūpasanto paṭipassaddho abhabbuppattiko ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍho, so vuccati akkodhano. kodhassa pahīnattā akkodhano, kodhavatthussa pariññātattā akkodhano, kodhahetussa upacchinnattā akkodhano'ti, akkodhano.

45137.meaning1: abandoned fear and dread; (comm) abandoned the causes of fear and dread
45137.commentary: (SNa) idha pana khīṇ'āsavānaṃ nirāsaṅkacāro nāma gahito. ten'ev'āha pahīnabhayabheravā'ti. tattha bhayaṃ bhayam'eva, bheravaṃ balavabhayaṃ. (THa) bhayahetūnaṃ kilesānaṃ samucchinnattā pahīnabhayabheravo

examples.text: upadhī te samatikkantā, āsavā te padālitā, sīho'va anupādāno, pahīnabhayabheravo.
santharitvāna saṅghāṭiṃ, seyyaṃ kappesi gotamo, sīho selaguhāyaṃ'va, pahīnabhayabheravo.

45138.meaning1: who has removed conceit; who has abandoned egotism; who has lost the tendency to compare

examples.text: pahīnamānassa na santi ganthā, vidhūpitā mānaganth'assa sabbe, sa vītivatto maññataṃ sumedho, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyya, loke samaññaṃ kusalo viditvā vohāramattena so vohareyyā'ti.
yass'indriyāni samathaṅ'gatāni, assā yathā sārathinā sudantā, pahīnamānassa anāsavassa, devā'pi tassa pihayanti tādino.
tassa evaṃ yoniso manasikaroto tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahīyanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā
maraṇena'pi taṃ pahīyati, yaṃ puriso mam'idan'ti maññati, etam'pi viditvā paṇḍito, na mamattāya nametha māmako.
sā kho pan'esā, bhikkhave, taṇhā kattha pahīyamānā pahīyati, kattha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati? yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.

45143.meaning1: was given up; was abandoned; vanished
45143.commentary: (ANa) sabbaso pahīyī'ti sabb'ākārena pahīno. maggena pahīnasadiso katvā dassito. na pan'esa maggena pahīno, paṭisaṅkhānena pahīno'va kathito'ti veditabbo. bodhisattassa hi devatā jarāpattaṃ dassesuṃ. tato paṭṭhāya yāva arahattā antarā mahāsattassa yobbanamado nāma na uppajjati.

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭīyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ na m'etaṃ assa patirūpan'ti. tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhato yo yobbane yobbanamado so sabbaso pahīyi.
yo mātaraṃ vā pitaraṃ vā, jiṇṇakaṃ gatayobbanaṃ, pahu santo na bharati, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
tattha addasa pahūtaṃ sukkhagūthaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ. disvān'assa etadahosi, ayaṃ kho pahuto sukkhagūtho chaḍḍito, mama ca sūkarabhattaṃ, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ ito sukkhagūthaṃ hareyyan'ti.
saṃvijjati kho, bho raṭṭhapāla, imasmiṃ rājakule pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ bhūmigatañ'ca vehāsagatañ'ca.
pahūtavitto puriso, sahirañño sabhojano, eko bhuñjati sādūni, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
kutopahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, kutopahūtā te tadiṅgha brūhi.
piyappahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, maccherayuttā kalahā vivādā, vivādajātesu ca pesuṇāni.

45150.meaning1: with much gold and silver; with abundant gold and money

examples.text: ye'pi te, mahārāja, khattiyamahāsālā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūtajātarūparajatā pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇā pahūtadhanadhaññā, tesam'pi jātānaṃ n'atthi aññatra jarāmaraṇā.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe nisinno passāmi khattiyamahāsāle'pi brāhmaṇamahāsāle'pi gahapatimahāsāle'pi aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsante.

45151.meaning1: with a large tongue; twenty-seventh of the thirty-two marks of a great man
45151.commentary: (MNa) pahūtajivho'ti aññesaṃ jivhā thūlā'pi hoti kisā'pi rassā'pi thaddhā'pi visamā'pi, tathāgatassa pana mudu dīghā puthulā vaṇṇasampannā hoti.

examples.text: pahūtajivho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
kacci pahūtajivho'si, yathā taṃ jāniyāmase, ninnāmay'etaṃ pahūtaṃ, kaṅkhaṃ vinaya no ise.

45152.meaning1: largeness of the tongue; fact of having a huge tongue

examples.text: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati, kos'ohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca.

45153.meaning1: auspicious marks of having a large tongue and a voice like god
45153.construction:
pahūtajivhā + brahmassara + lakkhaṇa + āni
pahūtajivhābrahmassaralakkhaṇa + āni

examples.text: ye'pi te, mahārāja, khattiyamahāsālā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūtajātarūparajatā pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇā pahūtadhanadhaññā, tesam'pi jātānaṃ n'atthi aññatra jarāmaraṇā.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe nisinno passāmi khattiyamahāsāle'pi brāhmaṇamahāsāle'pi gahapatimahāsāle'pi aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsante.

45155.meaning1: who has considerable wisdom; who has vast understanding

examples.text: antagū'si pāragū dukkhassa, arahā'si sammāsambuddho khīṇ'āsavaṃ taṃ maññe. jutimā mutimā pahūtapañño, dukkhass'antakaraṃ atāresi maṃ.
dīghā jaṅghā yassa so'yaṃ dīghajaṅgho, kalyāṇabhariyo, pahūtapañño.

45156.meaning1: having many sons; with many children

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? pahūtaputto hoti, anekasahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.

45157.meaning1: feeding on everything; very hungry; with big appetite
45157.meaning2: having much to eat or eating much
45157.commentary: (SNa) pahūtabhakkhan'ti bahubhakkhaṃ. aggissa hi abhakkhaṃ nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: pahūtabhakkhaṃ jālinaṃ, pāvakaṃ kaṇhavattaniṃ, daharo'ti n'āvajāneyya, na naṃ paribhave naro.

45159.commentary: (ANa) pahūtarattaratanānan'ti pahūtena rattasaṅkhātena ratanena samannāgatānaṃ, sakalajambudīpatalaṃ bheritalasadisaṃ katvā kaṭippamāṇehi sattahi ratanehi pūritānan'ti attho.

examples.text: na tv'eva, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti paṭikataṃ vā. imissā ca, bhikkhave, mahāpathaviyā pahūtasattaratanāya mātāpitaro issar'ādhipacce rajje patiṭṭhāpeyya, na tv'eva, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti paṭikataṃ vā. taṃ kissa hetu?

45160.meaning1: with massive wealth and resources; with vast properties and possessions; (comm) with large amount of material requisites for pleasure
45160.construction:
pahūta + vitta + upakaraṇa
pahūta + vitti + upakaraṇa

examples.text: ye'pi te, mahārāja, khattiyamahāsālā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūtajātarūparajatā pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇā pahūtadhanadhaññā, tesam'pi jātānaṃ n'atthi aññatra jarāmaraṇā.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe nisinno passāmi khattiyamahāsāle'pi brāhmaṇamahāsāle'pi gahapatimahāsāle'pi aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsante.

45161.meaning2: present fit to be sent to someone
45161.commentary: (VINa) yaṃkiñci paheṇak'atthāyā'ti paṇṇākār'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ yaṃkiñci atirasaka-modaka-sakkhalik'ādi sabbaṃ idha pūvotv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

examples.text: pūvaṃ nāma yaṃkiñci paheṇak'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ. manthaṃ nāma yaṃkiñci pātheyy'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ.

ime, bhante, licchavikumārakā caṇḍā pharusā apānubhā. yāni'pi tāni kulesu paheṇakāni pahīyanti, ucchū'ti vā badarā'ti vā pūvā'ti vā modakā'ti vā saṃkulikā'ti vā, tāni vilumpitvā vilumpitvā khādanti, kul'itthīnam'pi kulakumārīnam'pi pacch'āliyaṃ khipanti.

45163.meaning1: sake of a present; purpose of a gift
45163.commentary: (VINa) yaṃkiñci paheṇak'atthāyā'ti paṇṇākār'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ yaṃkiñci atirasaka-modaka-sakkhalik'ādi sabbaṃ idha pūvotv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

examples.text: pūvaṃ nāma yaṃkiñci paheṇak'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ. manthaṃ nāma yaṃkiñci pātheyy'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ.

45165.meaning1: comes into being (from); arises (from); proceeds (from); is a product (of)

examples.text: sammāvāyāmassa sammāsati pahoti, sammāsatissa sammāsamādhi pahoti, sammāsamādhissa sammāñāṇaṃ pahoti, sammāñāṇassa sammāvimutti pahoti
sātaṃ asātan'ti yam'āhu loke, tam'ūpanissāya pahoti chando, rūpesu disvā vibhavaṃ bhavañ'ca, vinicchayaṃ kubbati jantu loke.

45166.meaning1: is able (to); is capable (of); is qualified (to)

examples.text: bhagavā pana, bhante, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pahoti tathā kātuṃ yathā sabbo loko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti?
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave orabbhiko vā urabbhaghātako vā app'ekaccaṃ urabbhaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyamānaṃ pahoti hantuṃ vā bandhituṃ vā jāpetuṃ vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kātuṃ
so gantvā taṃ bhattaṃ pañcahi paccekabuddhasatehi saddhiṃ saṃvibhaji. taṃ tass'ānubhāvena sabbesam'pi pahoti. te olokentā'y'eva aṭṭhaṃsu.

45168.meaning1: coming into being (from); arising (from); proceeding (from); produced (by)
45168.construction:
pa + ho + ti + ka
pahoti + ka

examples.text: evaṃ ucchedavādimhi pahonte sassatavādī, puggalavādimhi pahonte suññatavādī, suññatavādimhi pahonte puggalavādī'ti evaṃ ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhāti nāma.

45172.commentary: (MNa) yugaggāhalakkhaṇo paḷāso, paraguṇehi attano guṇānaṃ samīkaraṇaraso, paresaṃ guṇappamāṇena upaṭṭhānapaccupaṭṭhāno.

examples.text: paḷāso cittassa upakkileso'ti, iti viditvā paḷāsaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.

kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti? yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno… paḷāsissa paḷāso appahīno hoti, issukissa issā appahīnā hoti, maccharissa macchariyaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti

45173.meaning1: who rivals; who is competitive; who is contentious

examples.text: upanāhissa upanāho appahīno hoti, makkhissa makkho appahīno hoti, paḷāsissa paḷāso appahīno hoti, issukissa issā appahīnā hoti, maccharissa macchariyaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti
pare paḷāsī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha apaḷāsī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

45174.meaning2: line, range, canon of the Buddhist writings or the language in which it is written

45180.meaning2: is delayed or spoiled, is obstructed

45182.meaning2: was delayed or spoiled, was obstructed

45183.meaning2: having delayed or spoiled, having obstructed

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
anāpatti sasaññissa, vissāsaggāhe, tāvakālike, petapariggahe, tiracchānagatapariggahe, paṃsukūlasaññissa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
so tattha allāni c'eva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, udakavātañ'ca dadeyya, paṃsukena ca okireyya.

so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, susāne seyyaṃ kappemi chav'aṭṭhikāni upadhāya. apissu maṃ, sāriputta, gāmaṇḍalā upasaṅkamitvā oṭṭhubhanti'pi, omuttenti'pi, paṃsukena'pi okiranti, kaṇṇasotesu'pi salākaṃ pavesenti.

45193.meaning1: covered in dust; smeared in dirt
45193.notes: The commentary's reading suggests paṃsuguṇṭhito is the correct spelling.

examples.text: imamhi naṃ padesamhi, puttakā paṃsukuṇṭhitā, paccuggatā maṃ tiṭṭhanti, vacchā bālā'va mātaraṃ.

45194.notes: The commentary's reading and PED suggest paṃsuguṇṭhito.

examples.text: sakuṇo yathā paṃsukunthito, vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajaṃ, evaṃ bhikkhu padhānavā satimā, vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajan'ti.
evam'evaṃ te paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa

45196.meaning1: robe from a rubbish heap; discarded cloth; rubbish rags

examples.text: paṃsukūladharaṃ jantuṃ, kisaṃ dhamanisanthataṃ, ekaṃ vanasmiṃ jhāyantaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
anuddhato acapalo, nipako saṃvut'indriyo, sobhati paṃsukūlena, sīho'va girigabbhare.

45197.meaning2: robe made of rags taken from dust-bins

examples.text: evam'evaṃ te paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa

45198.meaning1: perceiving as discarded; thinking of something as abandoned
45198.commentary: (VINa) paṃsukūlasaññissā'ti assāmikaṃ, idaṃ paṃsukūlan'ti evaṃsaññissā'pi gahaṇe anāpatti. sace pana taṃ sassāmikaṃ hoti, āharāpente dātabbaṃ.

examples.text: anāpatti sasaññissa, vissāsaggāhe, tāvakālike, petapariggahe, tiracchānagatapariggahe, paṃsukūlasaññissa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

45199.meaning1: ascetic who wears rag robes; rag robe wearer

examples.text: āraññiko hohi ca piṇḍapātiko, sosāniko hohi ca paṃsukūliko, nesajjiko hohi sadā dhute rato, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, bhikkhu paṃsukūliko rathiyāya nantakaṃ disvā vāmena pādena niggaṇhitvā dakkhiṇena pādena pattharitvā, yo tattha sāro taṃ paripātetvā ādāya pakkameyya.
